name: com.zegocloud.uikit.plugin.signaling.ZegoZPNsReceiver
description: When ZEGO's ZPNs signaling plugin broadcasts a message, notification, or registration update, this Receiver receives the event. This release adds no visible action to those events.
disableEffect: Blocking it removes this ZEGO push-event hook; no visible screen or action in this release depends on it.
